name: Shalini's story
before: A 7-year career break, two kids, and a quiet fear that the world had moved on.
after: Three months of weekly coaching, one bootcamp, and a job offer at a company she actually wanted.
quote: I wasn't just learning soft skills — I was learning to like the person I was becoming again.

name: Vivek's story
before: Top of his class on paper, frozen in every interview, convinced he just 'wasn't a people person'.
after: Now leads campus events, presents to 200+ students, and got 4 offers in his placement season.
quote: I didn't change my personality. I just stopped hiding it.
